details:
A few guys on discord recommend that i post this here since they were stumped on what was wrong with these avatars.
Im using the latest version of vrchat. 
I have 6 avatars which are all uploaded from the same project, they are all quest compatible, 3 use 1 model and 3 use a slightly altered model, the pc and quest versions use the same atlased material that is using the standard lite shader (to make it easier to upload and update the variants)
They work fine on pc, however in the quest version they cause a "double vision" where if i close one eye i can see it on the left, but if i close the other i can see it on the right. I can only see it in the avatar menu but i would assume others can see it due to a old problem i had with a broken shader on pc.
Im not really sure what exactly caused it, other than its probably shader based, so i dont really know how to recreate it, i also am not really sure how to screenshot it so ive decided to include a recreation of what it looks like in the menu.
Ive decided to also include a capture of the conversation since it seems like they understood the problem better than i did.
https://imgur.com/a/5qumh92
title: "Double Vision" on avatar using standard lite on quest
